item.title: Programs
item.description:
Our core programs support multiple disciplines through unrestricted funding, evaluated by annually appointed independent readers’ committees and juries composed of regional experts. The programs are revised periodically to reflect developments in artistic practice across the Arab region and its diasporas, offering close to 200 grants each year. 
 

In response to identified gaps in the region’s cultural sector, we offer dedicated programs that address sectoral, geographic and contextual realities through capacity building workshops and tailored knowledge-sharing initiatives. These special programs provide spaces for networking, collaboration, and strengthened communities of practice across the region’s cultural ecosystem.

item.title: Impact and Insights
item.description:
We are committed to transparency in everything we do. Our annual reports offer a snapshot of our work and the collective contributions of grantees, jurors, donors, and partners.

We work with experts to study arts and culture across the region, sharing research and insights that help us all better understand and support the cultural landscape in the Arab region.

item.title: Support Us
item.description:
Across the Arab world, artists, writers, researchers, and cultural institutions are creating new forms of expression, generating knowledge, experimenting with ideas, and opening spaces for dialogue and imagination. Their work depends on the time, resources, networks, and institutional support that allow creative practices to develop and take shape. Your contribution helps sustain these conditions, investing in artistic agency, creativity, experimentation, and the continued development of independent cultural work.

Whether you are an individual, a company, a grant-making organization, a cultural institution, or another partner, there are different ways to support AFAC and independent arts and culture across the Arab world.

Friends of AFAC is a global community of donors, advocates, and supporters committed to strengthening arts and culture across the Arab region.

Together, we ensure that artists and cultural institutions have the freedom, resources, and networks to create, challenge, preserve, and imagine.

As a Friend, your ongoing commitment through regular contributions becomes part of a growing movement building the future of cultural philanthropy in the Arab world, supporting independent artistic voices today while safeguarding our collective cultural legacy for generations to come.

Every contribution matters. A one-time gift helps expand the resources and opportunities available to artists and cultural organizations across the Arab world and supports the wider ecosystem in which their work can develop and reach audiences.

We work with grant-making institutions, companies, cultural organizations, and other partners that share our commitment to independent arts and culture in the Arab world. Partners can provide general support that gives AFAC the flexibility to sustain and develop its work; support a specific program or initiative; or sponsor and partner with us on events, gatherings, conferences, and other initiatives. We develop partnerships around shared interests and values while safeguarding the independence of our programs and grant-making.

We invite you to explore Impact & Insights, featuring stories and experiences from the projects we support and offering a closer look at the artists, cultural organizations, and practices at the heart of AFAC's work.
